title: Burn the Khepri Dawn Loop Chamber: Trial Mechanism
description: Burn the Khepri Dawn Loop Chamber: Trial Mechanism is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Sun-Scale Verdict Descent through The Sun-Scale Gate (Stable Gate under Ma’at strain). Your avatar of one selected deity's avatar from Aten Ra, Sutekh, Iset, Amunet enters; this beat spotlights Sutekh as the reference silhouette while preserving Avatar choice. The mission is the hazard step at Khepri Dawn Loop Chamber, using sacred judgment temple-road descent pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Solar Dominion of Khepra is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use Aten sun-discs with life-giving hand-rays, electrum collars, nemes-like light mantles, faience turquoise and lapis inlays, black Nile silt glass, red desert jasper, scarab engines, Ma’at feather geometry, solar barque arcs, pylon harnesses, lion/cobra/falcon/jackal threshold masks, lotus-papyrus river courts, and white-gold noon light.
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Sun-Scale Verdict Descent is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Khepri Dawn Loop Chamber and reveals: A hidden Amunet record implying the Gates predate mortal pharaoh-echoes. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Earth — Ancient Egypt, Desert Necropolis. pyramid complexes half-consumed by void-mist, sandstone tomb entrances cracked open, scattered sarcophagi, dune-covered funerary temples where Hollow seep through the stones. The avatar battles the Hollow in their mythological homeland, ancient era. No faction advantage — Earth is neutral ground.
